# Linnéa Aesthetic Clinic

Linnéa is a high-end aesthetic clinic in Tel Aviv, Israel. The clinic focuses on natural-looking aesthetic medicine, dual-doctor consultation, facial harmony planning, Botox, dermal fillers, facial contouring and advanced skin quality treatments.
